cards.ex: Colonizing Mars is a real moonshot project, but it could revolutionize our understanding of life.
cards.exUz: Marsni kolonizatsiya qilish haqiqiy ulkan loyiha, lekin u hayot haqidagi tushunchamizni inqilob qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Juda qiyin va ulkan maqsadli, ko'p resurs talab qiladigan loyiha.

cards.ex: The signals from that spacecraft have to travel through deep space before they reach Earth.
cards.exUz: Kosmik kemadan kelayotgan signallar Yergacha yetib borish uchun cheksiz koinotdan o'tishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Quyosh sistemasidan uzoqdagi koinot, yulduzlararo bo'shliq.

cards.ex: The gravitational pull of the moon affects the tides on Earth.
cards.exUz: Oyning tortishish kuchi Yerda suv toshqinlariga ta'sir qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Jisimning boshqa jismlarni o'ziga tortish kuchi.

cards.ex: Much of our everyday technology is actually space-age technology that was developed for NASA.
cards.exUz: Kundalik texnologiyalarimizning aksariyati aslida NASA uchun ishlab chiqilgan koinot texnologiyasidir.
cards.uzDef: Koinot tadqiqotlari uchun yaratilgan zamonaviy texnologiya.

cards.ex: Sometimes I like to go out at night and just contemplate the cosmos.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan men kechasi tashqariga chiqib, shunchaki koinot haqida o'ylashni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Koinotning ulkanligi va sirli tabiatini chuqur o'ylash.

cards.ex: Scientists are studying this newly discovered celestial body to determine its composition.
cards.exUz: Olimlar uning tarkibini aniqlash uchun yangi topilgan osmon jismni o'rganmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Koinotdagi tabiiy jism, masalan, yulduz, planeta yoki oy.

cards.ex: Ever since she was a child, she's had her eyes on the stars and dreamed of becoming an astronaut.
cards.exUz: U bolaligidan beri yulduzlarga nazar tashlab, astronavt bo'lishni orzu qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakka intilish, katta maqsadlarga erishishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: For many, space exploration represents the final frontier of human endeavor.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilik uchun koinotni o'rganish insoniyat harakatining so'nggi chegarasini anglatadi.
cards.uzDef: Koinotni tadqiq qilish, eng oxirgi noma'lum hudud.

cards.ex: The concept of a space elevator is fascinating, but the engineering challenges are immense.
cards.exUz: Kosmik lift konsepsiyasi hayratlanarli, ammo muhandislik muammolari juda katta.
cards.uzDef: Yer yuzasidan koinotga yuklarni olib chiqish uchun taklif etilayotgan inshoot.

cards.ex: Landing on the moon was a giant leap for mankind.
cards.exUz: Oyga qo'nish insoniyat uchun ulkan sakrash edi.
cards.uzDef: Katta yutuq, sezilarli taraqqiyot.

cards.ex: I wish we could travel at warp speed to visit other planets.
cards.exUz: Boshqa sayyoralarga tashrif buyurish uchun katta tezlikda sayohat qila olsak edi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy tezlikdan ancha yuqori bo'lgan tezlik.

cards.ex: We need to look to the future and invest in sustainable space exploration.
cards.exUz: Biz kelajakka qarashimiz va barqaror kosmik tadqiqotlarga sarmoya kiritishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakni o'ylash, rejalashtirish va unga tayyorlanish.

cards.ex: After the project was cancelled, his hopes for a space career fell back to earth.
cards.exUz: Loyiha bekor qilinganidan so'ng, uning kosmik karera orzulari amalga oshmay qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Orzularning amalga oshmasligi, umidsizlikka tushish.

cards.ex: Interstellar travel is currently beyond our technological capabilities, but scientists are working on it.
cards.exUz: Yulduzlararo sayohat hozircha texnologik imkoniyatlarimizdan tashqari, ammo olimlar bu borada ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yulduzlar orasida sayohat qilish, juda uzoq masofalarga borish.

cards.ex: During the Cold War, the space race between the US and the Soviet Union was intense.
cards.exUz: Sovuq urush davrida AQSh va Sovet Ittifoqi o'rtasidagi kosmik poyga shiddatli edi.
cards.uzDef: Davlatlar o'rtasida koinotni tadqiq qilishda raqobat.

cards.ex: Astronauts have to be protected from cosmic radiation during long spaceflights.
cards.exUz: Astronavtlar uzoq kosmik parvozlar davomida kosmik radiatsiyadan himoyalanishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Koinotdan keladigan yuqori energiyali zarrachalar va nurlar.

cards.ex: The search for alien life is one of the most exciting challenges in science.
cards.exUz: O'zga sayyoralik hayotni izlash fanning eng hayajonli vazifalaridan biridir.
cards.uzDef: Yer yuzidan tashqarida mavjud bo'lgan hayot shakllari.

cards.ex: The space program weathered the storm of budget cuts and continued its important work.
cards.exUz: Kosmik dastur byudjet qisqarishlari qiyinchiliklariga dosh berdi va o'zining muhim ishini davom ettirdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatni sabr bilan o'tkazib yuborish, muvaffaqiyatli yakunlash.

cards.ex: You should take those claims about alien sightings with a grain of salt.
cards.exUz: O'zga sayyoraliklar haqidagi da'volarga shubha bilan qarash kerak.
cards.term: take with a grain of salt
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotga to'liq ishonmaslik, uni shubha bilan qabul qilish.

cards.ex: Space tourism is becoming a reality, but it's still only for the very wealthy.
cards.exUz: Kosmik turizm haqiqatga aylanmoqda, ammo bu hali faqat juda boylar uchun.
cards.uzDef: Koinotga sayohat qilish, tijorat maqsadlarida tashkil etiladigan turizm.

cards.ex: Scientists are looking into the possibility of finding water on Mars.
cards.exUz: Olimlar Marsda suv topish imkoniyatini tekshirib ko'rmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani diqqat bilan o'rganib chiqish, tadqiq qilish.

cards.ex: The future of the space program is still up in the air due to funding issues.
cards.exUz: Kosmik dasturning kelajagi moliyalashtirish masalalari tufayli hali noaniq.
cards.uzDef: Hali hal qilinmagan, noaniq bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: A crewed mission to Mars is a long-term goal for many space agencies.
cards.exUz: Marsga ekipaj bilan parvoz ko'plab kosmik agentliklar uchun uzoq muddatli maqsad hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Mars sayyorasiga uyushtirilgan kosmik parvoz.

cards.ex: The discovery of a new planet could be a major scientific breakthrough.
cards.exUz: Yangi sayyoraning kashf etilishi katta ilmiy yutuq bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ilm-fanda katta kashfiyot, muhim yangilik.

cards.ex: Nothing can travel faster than light speed, according to current physics.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi fizika qonunlariga ko'ra, hech narsa yorug'lik tezligidan tezroq harakat qila olmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Yorug'likning vakuumdagi tezligi (sekundiga 299,792,458 metr).

cards.ex: Space exploration has led to many technological advancements that benefit society.
cards.exUz: Koinotni o'rganish jamiyatga foyda keltiradigan ko'plab texnologik yutuqlarga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Koinotni ilmiy maqsadlarda o'rganish, tadqiq qilish.

cards.ex: Interplanetary travel will require new propulsion systems and life support technologies.
cards.exUz: Sayyoralararo sayohat yangi harakatlantiruvchi tizimlar va hayotni ta'minlash texnologiyalarini talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Sayyoralar orasida sayohat qilish, kosmik parvozlar.

cards.ex: It's hard to get a new space startup off the ground because of the high costs.
cards.exUz: Yuqori xarajatlar tufayli yangi kosmik startapni ishga tushirish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Biror loyihani boshlash, amalga oshirish, ishga tushirish.

cards.ex: She was over the moon when she found out she was accepted into the astronaut program.
cards.exUz: U astronavtlar dasturiga qabul qilinganini bilgach, juda xursand bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda xursand bo'lish, baxtdan yetti osmonda uchish.

cards.ex: Space colonization could provide a backup plan for humanity in case of a disaster on Earth.
cards.exUz: Koinot kolonizatsiyasi Yerda falokat yuz berganda insoniyat uchun zaxira reja bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa sayyoralarda insonlar yashashi uchun sharoit yaratish.
